AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  MARCH 2, 2021
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20, N-29-20, AND N-35-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO
VIDEOCONFERENCED WITHOUT PROVIDING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS
DURING A MEETING, EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR CALL (669) 900-
6833; MEETING ID: 709 573 2685 DURING THE MEETING TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM. THE MEETING MAY BE
VIEWED ON FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3 OR ON THE CITY'S WEBPAGE AT:
https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393.
  6:00 PM
  VIDEOCONFERENCE
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  STUDY SESSION MEETING - 5:00 p.m.
 CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS

CLOSED SESSION

  I.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957(a):
  THREAT TO PUBLIC SERVICES OR FACILITIES – Consultation with the City Manager, Los Angeles
  County Sheriff representative, and other related City officials.

  II.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – ANTICIPATED LITIGATION PURSUANT  TO
  GOVERNMENT CODE §54956.9(d)(4) – Significant Exposure to Litigation in three cases.

  III.  CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATOR PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE
  §54956.8: Property: APN 8021-029-903; Negotiating Parties: Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager, and
  Norwalk La Mirada Unified School District; Under Negotiation: Price and Terms of Payment.

RECESS

  REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

INVOCATION
  Rick Ramirez
  Councilmember

FLAG SALUTE
  Tony Ayala
  Vice Mayor

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS

  I.  City Council to Proclaim March as National Social Service Worker month in the City of Norwalk.

  II.  City Council to recognize Public Safety and Social Services staff for exemplary service in assisting
  community members experiencing homelessness.

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS

  1.  COVID-19 Update.

  2.  Sheriff’s Department Update.

  3.  Tacos Gavilan and Taliza Coffee Ribbon Cutting.

  4.  Senior Center Quarterly Birthday Celebration.
   5.  Norwalk Connect, Call and Care Community Program.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meetings of
  February 16 and 23, 2021. 825-04

  Report

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period January 24, 2021 –
  February 6, 2021, in the total amount of $877,560.48. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period
  February 11, 2021 – February 24, 2021, in the total amount of $1,983,172.05. 640

  Report

  4.  PLANNING COMMISSION SYNOPSIS February 24, 2021 - Receive and File the 2020 Norwalk
  General Plan and Housing Element Annual Progress Report and direct staff to transmit the report to
  the Governor’s Office of Planning and Research and the Department of Housing and Community
  Development. 320

  Report

  5.  CONFIRM EMERGENCY WORK AT 11218 LAKELAND ROAD, 11637 DARTMOUTH DRIVE, AND
  16711 ERICK AVENUE - STEPHEN DORECK EQUIPMENT RENTALS, INC. – Staff recommends City
  Council confirm the emergency service repair work at 11218 Lakeland Road, 11637 Dartmouth Drive,
  and 16711 Erick Avenue, completed by Stephen Doreck Equipment Rentals, Inc., in the amount of
  $40,086.33. 955

  Report

  6.  ACCEPTANCE OF WORK – SKYLIGHT REPLACEMENT AT THE NORWALK ARTS & SPORTS
  COMPLEX (NASC) - Staff recommends City Council accept the work of Inter-Sky, Inc. in the amount of
  $69,809 for replacement of the barrel vault skylight at the NASC. 1005-04-7850

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  7.  ADVISORY BODIES - Staff recommends City Council appoint: Aiyana Ascencion, Ariana Audetat, Julio
  De La Hoja, Daniel Gonzalez, Ericka Huape, Morgan Kennedy, David Quintero, Ricardo Quintero,
  Celeste Rodriguez, Rosemary Rodriguez, Nina Rojas, Michelle Salto, Melanie Sandoval, Erik Solis,
  and Tatiana Valdovinos to the Youth Commission for a term ending March 31, 2022 and any other
  appointments to fill the vacancies on the various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

ORDINANCE AND RESOLUTIONS
   8.  ORDINANCE NO. 21-1723 - CONSIDERATION OF DATES FOR FUTURE ELECTIONS DUE TO
  NEW STATE OF CALIFORNIA LEGISLATION – Staff recommends City Council introduce for first
  reading by title only Ordinance No. 21-1723, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF NORWALK CHANGING THE DATE OF THE CITY’S GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION FROM
  THE FIRST TUESDAY AFTER THE FIRST MONDAY OF MARCH IN EVEN-NUMBERED YEARS TO
  THE FIRST TUESDAY AFTER THE FIRST MONDAY IN NOVEMBER IN EVEN-NUMBERED YEARS
  EFFECTIVE IN 2022.

  Report

  9.  PROJECT NO. 7924 - RESOLUTION NO. 21-07 - BUDGET AMENDMENT AND CONSTRUCTION
  CONTRACT CHANGE ORDER - LOCAL STREETS REHABILITATION PROGRAM - PHASE 1 ZONE
  24 - TO INCLUDE A PORTION OF PROJECT NO. 7185 - SHOEMAKER TRAFFIC MEDIAN
  IMPROVEMENTS, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 21-06 - Staff recommends City Council adopt
  Resolution No. 21-07, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK
  AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED BUDGET TO
  APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE PROPOSITION C FUNDS TO PROJECT NO. 7924 - CONSTRUCTION
  AND CONSTRUCTION SUPPORT SERVICES FOR LOCAL STREET REHABILITATION PROGRAM -
  PHASE 1 ZONE 24, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 21-06, in the amount of $135,000. 1005-04-
  7924

  Report

  10. PROJECT NO. 7925 - RESOLUTION NO. 21-08 - BUDGET AMENDMENT AND ADDITIONAL FUNDS
  FOR CONSTRUCTION OF LOCAL STREET REHABILITATION PROGRAM - PHASE 1 ZONE 27,
  ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 21-05 - Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 21-08, A
  RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN
  AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE AVAILABLE
  MEASURE "R" BOND PROCEEDS TO PROJECT NO. 7925 - CONSTRUCTION FOR LOCAL
  STREET REHABILITATION PROGRAM - PHASE 1 ZONE 27, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 21-05, in
  the amount of $230,000.  1005-04-7925

  Report

REPORTS

  11. AWARD OF CONTRACT – PROFESSIONAL SERVICES FOR CITYWIDE ON-STREET PARKING
  STUDY - Staff recommends City Council award a contract to Dixon Unlimited in an amount not to
  exceed $50,000 for professional services for the development of a citywide on-street parking study;
  and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement and any amendments, provided that there is
  funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney.

  Report

  12. CORONAVIRUS PANDEMIC - MARCH EMERGENCY OPERATIONS CENTER UPDATE - Receive
  and file.

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated February 26, 2021.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
